trust_decision.summary: Whether a caller may reach the MCP tools over the network is decided by the bind host plus the OAuth flag (ServerConfig defaults and the env loader) and enforced at startup in server.py:main(); what SQL the read-query tool may forward to the Pinot broker is decided one layer lower, inside PinotClient.execute_query before execute_query_http POSTs it.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names the default host 0.0.0.0 with OAuth off; the first place an engineer looks is the ServerConfig default (duplicated in the env loader at config.py:324) and the README note at README.md:207 that offers TLS as an alternative mitigation.

fix_sites.entry_point: mcp-pinot console script -> mcp_pinot.server:main (and any embedder constructing ServerConfig)
mcp-pinot console script -> main() HTTP and TLS branches
PinotClient.execute_query public API (also reached from the read_query tool)
package install (sqlglot dependency added to pyproject.toml dependencies)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: mcp_pinot_ops is a second, unpackaged Pinot client (pyproject.toml:41 packages=["mcp_pinot"]) whose server exposes no read-query tool, so it reads as dead/legacy code; and execute_query_http / execute_query_pinotdb read as internal helpers that only execute_query calls.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate read-only SQL that is not a bare SELECT must still be forwarded: WITH ... SELECT CTEs, ORDER BY ... DESC, a trailing Pinot OPTION(timeoutMs=...) clause (which preprocess_query itself appends on the pinotdb path), a trailing semicolon, and semicolons or comment markers inside quoted string literals. A regex/startswith fix or a bare sqlglot.parse_one rejects these; the fix keeps them by hand-stripping comments, splitting on unquoted semicolons and removing only a trailing OPTION clause.

O6_input_shapes: line and block comments, including keyword obfuscation such as DR/**/OP
semicolons and comment markers inside quoted string literals

O8_uncovered_routes.route: PinotClient.execute_query_http POSTs the SQL straight to the broker /query/sql with no read-only validation
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: it looks like an internal alternative HTTP transport reached only through execute_query, so validating in the wrapper seems sufficient
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, one method above the fix site

O8_uncovered_routes.route: PinotClient.execute_query_pinotdb executes the query through the pinotdb cursor with no read-only validation
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: it is the fallback used after execute_query has already validated, so it seems covered

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Pinot._execute_query runs arbitrary SQL on a pinotdb cursor with neither a read-only check nor the table filter
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: unpackaged legacy package with no read-query tool wired to it

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an MCP_HOST override injected through env.additional / configMap / secret
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the chart already offers free-form env injection while validateExposure only inspects .Values.mcp.host, so a maintainer adding extraEnv would not think to re-check the bind host

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a read-query tool wired to Pinot._execute_query
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the sibling client already implements arbitrary SQL execution and manifest.json:37 advertises a read-query tool, so wiring it is the obvious next commit

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second SQL rewrite/validation point inside preprocess_query
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: preprocess_query already rewrites SQL (database prefix, OPTION clause) on the pinotdb path, so a maintainer hardening SQL could add the check there instead

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a fourth transport branch or a --host CLI flag that starts HTTP without passing http_enabled
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: main() already has three branches and transport is a free-form string from the env

O8b_injection_room.sibling: another 0.0.0.0 default with the S104 'bind all interfaces' lint rule suppressed
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: S104 is explicitly ignored, so a new HTTP entry point defaulting to all interfaces would pass lint silently

O9_family: CWE-306 missing authentication for critical function, bundled with read-only SQL enforcement (CWE-89/CWE-20-style input validation)

O10_build.toolchain: uv / pip + setuptools (pyproject.toml, uv.lock); pytest + pytest-asyncio; ruff
O10_build.project_tests: tests/test_server.py drives the real FastMCP app in-process with mcp_pinot.server.pinot_client patched (tests/test_server.py:10-34, 110-146); tests/test_pinot_client.py patches requests and create_connection (tests/test_pinot_client.py:29-52) so execute_query validation runs offline; tests/test_config.py covers ServerConfig/load_server_config defaults. The fix's added dependency sqlglot>=30.8.0 needs network at install time only.
